design.rounding: Reuse deterministic largest-remainder integerization; continuous optimum retained as lower bound, not integer optimality.
design.prices: One shared exogenous Gaussian innovation matrix for all cases and all strategies; same minute-start reference prices.
design.volume: Five positive synthetic forecast curves known before execution. Matched or circularly shifted realized weights used only for VWAP evaluation.
design.impact: constant: a_k=eta/tau. secondary assumption: a_k=eta/(tau*N*vhat_k), fixed at design time; not fitted from data and not recomputed from realized VWAP weights.
design.benchmarks: Sell cost: Q*arrival_price-proceeds; separately Q*market_VWAP-proceeds, where market_VWAP uses external interval-start prices and exogenous volume weights.
design.inference: 95% Student-t CIs for Monte Carlo mean shortfall and paired mean differences only when all three schedules and reference prices are valid. Retain all invalid paths; no conditional-selection superiority claims.
design.limits: No order book, participation caps, volume forecast learning, broker algorithm replication, real traded-VWAP data or live execution.
